revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, observing a utility-room passage. Rear-oblique view, medium-wide framing, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Scene includes cabinets, conduits, inspection access panels, large neutral floor and wall tiles, and partial shadow from nearby structure while keeping the subject clear. Visible subject is a middle-aged adult with a medium build wearing a tan utility jacket and dark jeans, light neutral clothing, performing a controlled plank beside a marked work area, with hands and feet actively supporting the body and no passive ground rest. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, doorway and structural lines creating depth without blocking the subject. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, not cinematic or advertising style. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or artificial annotation.
